- [ ] N5 `filing-gate.md` L35: the code span runs into 「逐项勾」 with no separator; 「接受偏差」 here vs 「接受的偏差」 in `contract-review.md` L42.
- [ ] N6 `contract-review.md` L51 「无前两级」 leaves implicit that a finding closed by a later same-head record no longer counts; the route is stated only in PR #33736's refusal text and brief.

Carried elsewhere: `landing-operations.md` L13 (PR #33732).
